lines.t:
A type of <c:ffff00>stat<c> for head, arm and leg <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> and
<c:ffff00>objects<c>: how much <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> they can withstand.

It drops when taking {{enemy}} <c:ffff00>attacks<c>; at 0, the {{part}} or
{{object}} is <c:ffff00>destroyed<c>.
<c:ffff00>{{recover|cap}}<c> <c:ffff00>actions<c> or <c:ffff00>positive effects<c> raise it up to its
initial value.
It fully recovers when the <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> ends.
